plainText:
----
 
 
Can You Name All the Pokémon? BW (Japanese: ポケモン言えるかな？ＢＷ Pokémon Ierukana? BW) is the second Japanese ending theme of Pokémon the Series: Black & White. It appeared first as a commercial, and debuted as an ending in BW026, replacing Fanfare of the Heart.

A cover of the song sung by and arranged by eba was used in promotional videos for the expansion of the Pokémon Trading Card Game on June 2025.

==Ending animation: BW ED 2==
===Synopsis===
The entire ending sequence generally consists of acting as DJ, though just pointing about. The first variation takes place at night, while the second variation takes place during the day. Pokémon on a multi-platformed stage are unshadowed as their names are said. The scene eventually shifts to a bunch of lights, where other Pokémon appear as well. In the first variation, the scene goes back to the stage, while in the second variation, it goes to running on a disc, later with a sparkling electric trail behind it. Pikachu also says its name during specific episodes. After that, in both variations, Pikachu, , , and are then shown doing various things. Everything then goes back to the stage before everything shatters like glass, causing Meowth to enter a white ball of light in the background. The last set of Pokémon are then shown, ending with , who, much like Pikachu, occasionally says its name.

==Black Bolt/White Flare version==
The song was covered by and arranged by eba for two promotional videos for the expansion of the Pokémon Trading Card Game. All Generation V Pokémon (including , , and , who aren't mentioned in the song lyrics) are represented as cards from the TCG expansions. The original version was uploaded to YouTube on June 2, 2025 and featured the Regular prints for each card. The Special Edition was uploaded to YouTube on June 20, 2025, and featured the Full Art and prints for each card.
